newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline sheds $5 as crude takes tumble.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline sheds $5 as crude takes tumble.

text.p: NWE gasoline eased lower on Thursday as IPE Brent futures fell heavily, traders said.
Eurograde barges talked around $214/$215 late in the day having traded earlier at $220 a tonne fob ARA.
Regular unleaded barges also shed $5 to trade late at $203.
On cargoes, bids for premium unleaded product slid to the low $220s cif NWE with offers in the mid $220s despite uncovered requirements seen into the U.K. Thames and into Hamburg.
Buying for superplus was still seen into France with product scarce.
